files_summary.state.json: GorillaFileSystem state: flat nodes dict keyed by absolute path. Directories have type=directory + children list; files have type=file + content string. cwd=/workspace, root_name=workspace. Tree has src/, data/, docs/, config/, logs/, scripts/, tests/ with ~30 realistic files (py, csv, json, yml, md, log, sh) for diverse cat/grep/find/ls outputs.
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: cd
tool_schemas.description: Changes the current working directory to the given folder name and returns the updated working directory. It refuses requests where the folder does not exist, is not a directory, or is not reachable from the current location. It also refuses folder values that attempt to use paths (for example containing separators or traversal) rather than a single directory name.

folder.description: The folder of the directory to change to. You can only change one folder at a time.

tool_schemas.name: cp
tool_schemas.description: Copies a file or directory from the current directory into the given destination and returns the resulting copied entry information. It refuses requests where the source does not exist in the current directory, or where the destination is invalid (including any destination value that is a path rather than a local name). It also refuses copies that would conflict with an existing non-directory entry at the destination or that would require copying into a destination directory that does not exist.

source.description: The name of the file or directory to copy.

destination.description: The destination name to copy the file or directory to. If the destination is a directory, the source will be copied into this directory. No file paths allowed.

tool_schemas.name: diff
tool_schemas.description: Compares two files in the current directory line by line and returns the differences. It refuses requests where either name does not exist, refers to a directory, or cannot be read as a file. It also refuses comparisons when both names resolve to the same file entry.

file_name1.description: The name of the first file in current directory.

file_name2.description: The name of the second file in current directorry.

tool_schemas.name: du
tool_schemas.description: Estimates and returns the total size of the current directory and its contents, optionally formatted in human-readable units. It refuses requests when the current working directory is not set to a valid directory. It also refuses requests with non-boolean values for human_readable.

human_readable.description: If True, returns the size in human-readable format (e.g., KB, MB).

tool_schemas.name: echo
tool_schemas.description: If file_name is provided, writes the given content into that file in the current directory and returns the written content or a write confirmation; if file_name is not provided, returns the content as output. It refuses write requests when file_name is not a local file name, when the target exists as a directory, or when the current directory is not valid. It also refuses requests missing content or where content is not a string.

content.description: The content to write or display.

file_name.description: The name of the file at current directory to write the content to. Defaults to None.

tool_schemas.name: find
tool_schemas.description: Searches under the given starting directory (defaulting to the current directory) and returns matching files and directories, optionally filtered by exact name. It refuses requests where the start path does not exist or is not a directory. It also refuses name values that are not a single entry name (for example path-like values) and path values that are not valid within the workspace.

path.description: The directory path to start the search. Defaults to the current directory (".").

name.description: The name of the file or directory to search for. If None, all items are returned.

tool_schemas.name: ls
tool_schemas.description: Lists the entries in the current directory and returns their names (and may include hidden entries when a=true). It refuses requests when the current working directory is not set to a valid directory. It also refuses requests where a is provided but is not a boolean.

a.description: Show hidden files and directories. Defaults to False.

tool_schemas.name: mkdir
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new directory with the given name in the current directory and returns the created directory entry. It refuses requests where dir_name is invalid or path-like, where an entry with the same name already exists, or where the current directory is not valid. It also refuses names that are empty or reserved for navigation.

dir_name.description: The name of the new directory at current directory. You can only create directory at current directory.

tool_schemas.name: mv
tool_schemas.description: Moves or renames a file or directory within the current directory and returns the updated entry location/name. It refuses requests where the source does not exist in the current directory or where source and destination are the same. It also refuses destination values that are path-like, that would overwrite an existing non-directory entry, or that specify a destination directory that does not exist when moving into a directory.

source.description: Source name of the file or directory to move. Source must be local to the current directory.

destination.description: The destination name to move the file or directory to. Destination must be local to the current directory and cannot be a path. If destination is not an existing directory like when renaming something, destination is the new file name.

tool_schemas.name: pwd
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current working directory path. It refuses requests when no working directory is set or when the current working directory no longer exists. It also refuses any unexpected parameters.

tool_schemas.name: rm
tool_schemas.description: Removes the named file or directory from the current directory and returns a confirmation of what was removed. It refuses requests where the name is missing/empty, refers to a path (not a local name), or does not exist in the current directory. It also refuses removal when the target cannot be removed in its current state (for example, a non-empty directory or a directory that must be removed via the directory-specific operation).

file_name.description: The name of the file or directory to remove.

tool_schemas.name: rmdir
tool_schemas.description: Removes the named directory from the current directory and returns a confirmation of the removal. It refuses requests where the name is missing/empty, refers to a path (not a local name), or does not exist in the current directory. It also refuses if the target is not a directory or if the directory is not empty.

dir_name.description: The name of the directory to remove. Directory must be local to the current directory.

tool_schemas.name: sort
tool_schemas.description: Reads the named file in the current directory, sorts its contents line-by-line, writes the sorted result back to the file, and returns the sorted content. It refuses requests where the file name is missing/empty, refers to a path (not a local name), or does not exist in the current directory. It also refuses if the target is a directory or otherwise cannot be read and updated as a text file.

file_name.description: The name of the file appeared at current directory to sort.

tool_schemas.name: touch
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new empty file with the given local name in the current directory and returns confirmation (and the created entry). It refuses requests where the file name is missing/empty, contains a path separator, or is otherwise not a valid local file name for this workspace. It also refuses if an entry with the same name already exists in the current directory.

file_name.description: The name of the new file in the current directory. file_name is local to the current directory and does not allow path.

tool_schemas.name: wc
tool_schemas.description: Counts content in the named file in the current directory and returns the requested count based on mode: lines ('l'), words ('w'), or characters ('c'). It refuses requests where the file name is missing/empty, refers to a path (not a local name), or the file does not exist in the current directory. It also refuses if mode is not one of the supported values or if the target is not a readable file.

file_name.description: Name of the file of current directory to perform wc operation on.

mode.description: Mode of operation ('l' for lines, 'w' for words, 'c' for characters).

tool_schemas.name: cat
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full contents of the named file in the current directory as text. It refuses requests where the file name is missing/empty, refers to a path (not a local name), or the file does not exist in the current directory. It also refuses if the target is a directory or is not readable as a file.

file_name.description: The name of the file from current directory to display. No path is allowed.

tool_schemas.name: grep
tool_schemas.description: Searches the named file in the current directory for lines containing the given pattern and returns the matching lines (in file order). It refuses requests where the file name or pattern is missing/empty, where the file name refers to a path (not a local name), or where the file does not exist in the current directory. It also refuses if the target is not a readable file.

file_name.description: The name of the file to search. No path is allowed and you can only perform on file at local directory.

tool_schemas.name: tail
tool_schemas.description: Returns the last N lines of the named file in the current directory (defaulting to 10). It refuses requests where the file name is missing/empty, refers to a path (not a local name), or the file does not exist in the current directory. It also refuses if lines is not a positive integer or if the target is not a readable file.

file_name.description: The name of the file to display. No path is allowed and you can only perform on file at local directory.

lines.description: The number of lines to display from the end of the file. Defaults to 10.

metadata.name: Workspace File Desk
metadata.description: Provides an in-memory workspace file system with shell-like commands to navigate directories and create, list, search, compare, and manipulate files and folders.
